# sofa

**An easy interface to CouchDB from R**

sofa docs: <https://docs.ropensci.org/sofa/>

## CouchDB versions

`sofa` works with CouchDB v2 and v3. See [the
builds](https://github.com/ropensci/sofa/actions?query=workflow%3AR-check)
for checks on various CouchDB versions.

## CouchDB Info

- Docs:
  [http://docs.couchdb.org/en/latest/index.html](http://docs.couchdb.org/en/latest/index.md)
- Installation:
  [http://docs.couchdb.org/en/latest/install/index.html](http://docs.couchdb.org/en/latest/install/index.md)

## Connect to CouchDB

This may be starting it on your terminal/shell

``` R
couchdb
```

Or opening the CouchDB app on your machine, or running it in Docker.
Whatever it is, start it up.

## Install sofa

From CRAN

``` R
install.packages("sofa")
```

Development version from GitHub

``` R
remotes::install_github("ropensci/sofa")

library('sofa')
```

## Cushions

Cushions? What? Since it’s couch we gotta use `cushions` somehow.
`cushions` are a connection class containing all connection info to a
CouchDB instance. See
[`?Cushion`](https://docs.ropensci.org/sofa/reference/Cushion.md) for
help.

As an example, connecting to a remote CouchDB-compatible service:

``` R
z <- Cushion$new(
  host = "example.com",
  transport = 'https',
  port = NULL,
  user = 'foobar',
  pwd = 'things'
)
```

Break down of parameters:

- `host`: the base url, without the transport (`http`/`https`)
- `path`: context path that is appended to the end of the url
- `transport`: `http` or `https`
- `port`: The port to connect to. Default: 5984. For Cloudant, have to
  set to `NULL`
- `user`: User name for the service.
- `pwd`: Password for the service, if any.
- `headers`: headers to pass in all requests

If you call `Cushion$new()` with no arguments you get a cushion set up
for local use on your machine, with all defaults used.

``` R
x <- Cushion$new()
```

Ping the server

``` R
x$ping()
```

Nice, it’s working.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`Cushion`](https://docs.ropensci.org/sofa/reference/Cushion.md) :
  sofa connection client
- [`active_tasks()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/sofa/reference/active_tasks.md)
  : active tasks
- [`doc_attach_create()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/sofa/reference/attachments.md)
  [`doc_attach_info()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/sofa/reference/attachments.md)
  [`doc_attach_get()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/sofa/reference/attachments.md)
  [`doc_attach_delete()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/sofa/reference/attachments.md)
  : Work with attachments
- [`databases`](https://docs.ropensci.org/sofa/reference/databases.md) :
  Work with databases in CouchDB.
- [`db_alldocs()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/sofa/reference/db_alldocs.md)
  : List all docs in a given database.
- [`db_bulk_create()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/sofa/reference/db_bulk_create.md)
  : Create documents via the bulk API
- [`db_bulk_get()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/sofa/reference/db_bulk_get.md)
  : Query many documents at once
- [`db_bulk_update()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/sofa/reference/db_bulk_update.md)
  : Create documents via the bulk API
- [`db_changes()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/sofa/reference/db_changes.md)
  : List changes to a database.
- [`db_compact()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/sofa/reference/db_compact.md)
  : Request compaction of the specified database
- [`db_create()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/sofa/reference/db_create.md)
  : Create a database.
- [`db_delete()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/sofa/reference/db_delete.md)
  : Delete a database.
- [`db_explain()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/sofa/reference/db_explain.md)
  : Explain API
- [`db_index()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/sofa/reference/db_index.md)
  [`db_index_create()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/sofa/reference/db_index.md)
  [`db_index_delete()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/sofa/reference/db_index.md)
  : Create and get database indexes
- [`db_info()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/sofa/reference/db_info.md) :
  List database info.
- [`db_list()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/sofa/reference/db_list.md) :
  List all databases.
- [`db_query()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/sofa/reference/db_query.md) :
  Query a database.
- [`db_replicate()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/sofa/reference/db_replicate.md)
  : Upload (replicate) a local database to a remote CouchDB-compatible
  server
- [`db_revisions()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/sofa/reference/db_revisions.md)
  : Get document revisions.
- [`design_create()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/sofa/reference/design.md)
  [`design_create_()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/sofa/reference/design.md)
  [`design_delete()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/sofa/reference/design.md)
  [`design_get()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/sofa/reference/design.md)
  [`design_head()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/sofa/reference/design.md)
  [`design_info()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/sofa/reference/design.md)
  : Work with design documents
- [`design_search()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/sofa/reference/design_search.md)
  [`design_search_many()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/sofa/reference/design_search.md)
  : Search design documents
- [`doc_create()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/sofa/reference/doc_create.md)
  : Create documents to a database.
- [`doc_delete()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/sofa/reference/doc_delete.md)
  : Delete a document in a database.
- [`doc_get()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/sofa/reference/doc_get.md) :
  Get a document from a database.
- [`doc_head()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/sofa/reference/doc_head.md) :
  Get header info for a document
- [`doc_update()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/sofa/reference/doc_update.md)
  : Update a document.
- [`doc_upsert()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/sofa/reference/doc_upsert.md)
  : Create a new document or update an existing one
- [`documents`](https://docs.ropensci.org/sofa/reference/documents.md) :
  Work with documents in CouchDB.
- [`membership()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/sofa/reference/membership.md)
  : membership
- [`parse_df()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/sofa/reference/parse_df.md) :
  Parse data.frame to json or list by row or column
- [`ping()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/sofa/reference/ping.md) : Ping a
  CouchDB server
- [`restart()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/sofa/reference/restart.md) :
  Restart your CouchDB instance
- [`session()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/sofa/reference/session.md) :
  session
- [`sofa-package`](https://docs.ropensci.org/sofa/reference/sofa-package.md)
  [`sofa`](https://docs.ropensci.org/sofa/reference/sofa-package.md) : R
  client for CouchDB.
- [`uuids()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/sofa/reference/uuids.md) : Get
  uuids.
